## About Saiman Sah
Saiman Sah is the Chairperson and Chairman of AI Alliance (Nepal). In this role, he leads nationwide initiatives to accelerate artificial intelligence innovation, ethical AI frameworks, open-source technology development, and youth developer enablement across the Nepali tech ecosystem.

Alongside his executive leadership at AI Alliance (Nepal), Saiman Sah is an accomplished full-stack software engineer and self-taught systems specialist, architecting high-performance web applications using Next.js, TypeScript, React, and Python, as well as low-level systems in C/C++ and Rust.
